description: This bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," illustrates the runtime in seconds for different models, with the horizontal axis listing five categories: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," ranges from 0 to 400 in a linear scale, marked with dashed gridlines at intervals of 50. A legend in the top-left corner indicates that the green bars represent "Our Joint Framework" and the blue bars represent "LLM Models." The chart displays one green bar for "Our Joint Framework" with a value of 77 seconds, and four blue bars for the LLM models: "ChatGPT" at 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" at 365 seconds, "LLaMA" at 172 seconds, and "Claude" at approximately 245 seconds (the exact value is obscured by a gray overlay). The bars are arranged in the order listed on the horizontal axis and are not sorted. The green bar for "Our Joint Framework" is visually distinct from the blue bars, which represent the LLM models. The chart does not include any annotations or visual emphasis beyond the numerical labels on top of each bar.
